about.en:
Liderator is Bank of Georgia's 8-month, fully paid programme running since 2017. It starts with a training stage for technical and soft skills, then participants work in the bank with a personal mentor, rotating through teams. The standard day is 8 hours but is fitted to your academic timetable, and participants get 7 extra days off for exams.

In 2026 applicants chose up to three of 12 tracks, including finance and banking, business development, HR, marketing, business analytics and reporting, data science and banking law. Selection has a general aptitude test, a field-specific test or presentation, and an interview. The bank says about 78% of participants continue their career at the bank.

The 2027 call has not been announced yet; follow the bank's student blog and careers page in January.

en: Fully paid 8-month programme with rotations
Personal mentor and training stage
Schedule fitted to your studies; 7 extra exam days

about.en:
Launched on the Prime Minister's initiative under Government Resolution No. 177 (15 May 2023, Rules for Internship in a Public Institution), the programme places students and graduates in ministries and their agencies. In 2026 more than 3,000 places were offered; for example the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture and the Ministry of Education each advertised hundreds of posts.

Each ministry or agency posts its own internship vacancies on the vacancy portal run by the Government Administration (hr.gov.ge / vacancy.hr.gov.ge). Selection is usually in two stages: document screening, then an interview.

Check the portal in late summer for the next round.

en: Paid, 3 months in a ministry or state agency

Single official portal for all vacancies

KPMG Georgia lists intern posts on its vacancies page under Audit, Tax and Advisory. The Tax Intern role, for example, is full-time in Tbilisi, targets recent bachelor's graduates (preferably economics or finance) fluent in Georgian and English, and covers tax advisory support, bookkeeping and tax reporting for clients.

Applicants email an English CV to the Tbilisi HR address given in each posting, with the position title in the subject line. Strong interns are commonly considered for permanent roles.
